text:
Use `git show` to see the diff:

```bash
git show --stat HEAD
```

Or just:

```bash
git diff HEAD~1 HEAD
```

Or to see the actual file changes:

```bash
git show HEAD --name-only
```

To see what was added/removed:

```bash
git show HEAD --stat
```

For a detailed diff:

```bash
git show HEAD --name-status
```

`git show HEAD` shows the full diff. `HEAD~1` is the previous commit. Use whichever gives you the level of detail you need.
